title: momo-audio
summary: A complete e-commerce template platform — catalogue, cart, checkout, CMS, documentation and a full social content kit. Built once to be licensed many times.
constraint: A template has to be generic and opinionated at the same time. Too specific and nobody else can use it; too generic and it is a blank page with a cart bolted on.

decision.body: The contract is the product. Every entity is defined as a schema the front end owns, and the CMS implements that schema rather than defining it — so a buyer can run the platform on their existing back end without touching a component.
decision.rejectedOption: Generating types from the CMS schema. Faster to start, but it inverts the dependency and turns migration into a rewrite.

result.note: Not yet measured. Figures will be added once the licensing listing is live.

title: NexGen Electrical Innovations
summary: Next.js and TypeScript on a Strapi-ready headless stack. Fast, fully indexable, and editable by an owner who does not write code.
constraint: The owner needed to edit the site without a developer, on a budget that ruled out a bespoke admin build.

decision.body: Headless CMS with a tightly constrained content model, so the editor cannot break the layout. Fewer knobs beats more flexibility when the person using it is not a designer.
